content.text:
Updated `safety_evals` to match all ten sections of `SPEC.md`. Flag rates now count only `True` as flagged, keep `None` in the denominator, and weight each transcript equally when pooling. The parser now handles all three flag values, skips blank lines and comments, and reports original line numbers for malformed input. Deduplication keeps the last record for each ID, and daily counts and summaries use calendar-day windows.

The package-wide review also fixed group ranking, per-group rate ordering, and streak counting. I updated the README API list and added regression tests for `None` flags, duplicate IDs, and other edge cases.

`python -m pytest`: 25 passed.
